name: artsteps
title: artsteps.com
shortDescription: Artsteps allows users to create immersive VR exhibitions easily. It is designed for artists, educators, and marketers who wish to showcase digital content in a virtual space. Users can upload images, videos, and 3D models, add music, and narrate to craft unique VR experiences. An example use case is a museum creating a virtual tour of their latest exhibits.
pros: Easy to use VR creation tools
Options for social sharing and community engagement
cons: Requires VR compatible hardware for full experience
May have limited customization in free tier
Premium services necessary for advanced features
